requirements.name: Any admin page requires the user to be signed in

scenarios.name: Opening the admin dashboard unauthenticated requires signing in first

tests.test: lands on the sign in page when opening the admin dashboard
allows signing into the admin dashboard
redirectTo builds /auth/sign-in redirect including pathname and search
tests.notes: proves the unauthenticated redirect URL carries the requested path, not the post-sign-in landing

scenarios.name: Opening a deeper admin page unauthenticated requires signing in first

tests.test: lands on the sign in page when opening a page further in the journey
allows signing into a page further in the journey
tests.notes: asserts return to notifications, not the dashboard

tests.test: returns redirect when redirect starts with "/"
getBellOptions.location stores safe redirect and returns redirectUrl
tests.notes: stores the requested path for post-sign-in return

requirements.name: Empty or invalid sign-in credentials show one generic error

scenarios.name: Empty credentials, or an empty password alone, are both rejected the same way

tests.test: displays an error message when signing in with empty credentials
displays an error message when signing in with empty password
tests.notes: asserts the identical error text as the empty-credentials test

requirements.name: Signing out ends the session and requires signing in again to return

scenarios.name: Signing out shows a confirmation and locks the admin dashboard again

tests.test: allows signing out after signing in
lands on the sign in page when reopening the admin dashboard after sign out
clears auth and yar cookies before redirecting
tests.notes: proves session cookies are cleared on sign-out; does not assert the confirmation page

requirements.name: The admin dashboard shows the signed-in user's identity

scenarios.name: The admin dashboard shows who is signed in

tests.test: displays signed in user after signing in
Should describe the signed-in user from their session
tests.notes: builds userSession.displayName for templates; does not assert the dashboard markup
